You have to attend a workshop in Vilnius between day 18 and day 22. You would like to visit Frankfurt for 3 days. You are going to attend a wedding in Frankfurt between day 16 and day 18.

{"itinerary": [{"day_range": "Day X-Y", "place": "<CITY>"}]}. Include all city visits with their day ranges. Do not include separate flight entries in the JSON output.
